extractedItems.title: Penalty for Playing the Wrong Ball
extractedItems.question: You hit someone else’s ball by mistake and play your shot. What do you need to do now?

choices.text: Continue playing with the wrong ball and take no penalty
Go back, play your own ball, and add 2 penalty strokes
Drop a new ball and take 1 penalty stroke
Replace the wrong ball with your ball but ignore the shot

extractedItems.explanation: If you play the wrong ball, you must go back and play your own ball from its original spot with 2 penalty strokes.

extractedItems.title: Cleaning Up Sand Before Next Bunker Shot
extractedItems.question: After your first shot in a bunker, the ball stays in the same bunker but further ahead. Are you allowed to rake the sand from your previous shot before playing again?

choices.text: Yes, and you can also ground your club before playing
No, you cannot touch the sand at all
Yes, but you still can’t ground your club or touch the sand during a practice swing
No, the bunker must be left as it is

extractedItems.explanation: You may rake the marks from your first shot, but you still can’t ground your club behind the ball or during a practice swing.
